llms:
Formula lineWeights[arc e -> f] = baseCost >= 0 ? baseCost + max(turnCost, 0) : -1, where baseCost = weights[f] is the cost of the NEXT edge f (not of the entering edge e) and turnCost = getTurnCost(e, f) = angleCost * |angle| plus the left or right extra beyond straightAngle; a turn with |angle| >= uTurnAngle pays uTurnCost instead, and a negative uTurnCost bans it (no arc is emitted). Banned pairs are removed too, so every emitted arc has turnCost >= 0. The angle is between the great-circle arrival bearing of e and the departure bearing of f at the turn node, positive to the left. Arcs of one edge are listed in ascending next-edge order.

- bound symbols: 3/3
- compute passes were not coalesced as in production
- lens twin: transients lineOffsets, lineNeighbors, lineWeights, arcCount, overflow retained instead of aliased
